subject: quantitative_aptitude
question: A can complete a piece of work in 12 days, and B can complete the same work in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they complete the work?
explanation: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/24 = (2 + 1) / 24 = 3 / 24 = 1/8 work per day. Hence, working together they finish in 8 days.

subject: quantitative_aptitude
question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 15 hours, while Pipe B can empty the full tank in 20 hours. If both pipes are opened simultaneously in an empty tank, how many hours will it take to fill the tank completely?
explanation: Net rate per hour = 1/15 - 1/20 = (4 - 3) / 60 = 1/60 tank per hour. Therefore, the tank fills in 60 hours.

subject: quantitative_aptitude
question: P is twice as efficient as Q. If Q alone takes 18 days to finish a task, how many days will P and Q take working together?
explanation: Since P is twice as efficient as Q, P takes half the time of Q = 18 / 2 = 9 days. Together, rate = 1/9 + 1/18 = (2 + 1) / 18 = 3 / 18 = 1/6 task per day. Time required = 6 days.
